Public signed reserve transactions and genesis from the six-validator checkpoint at height 972. Block headers retain their pinned identities; certificate votes are omitted here because these small fixtures test compatibility selection, not certificate verification. Full unmodified archive replay is the integration gate. No private keys.

The synthetic-series-ledger fixture uses public asset/profile/bucket rows with a restored series balance and issuer sequence to isolate reserve validation. It is not a certified historical checkpoint.
